notes.title: New Anomalies!
notes.content:
To everyone stuck wandering the halls of Exit 8,



 To celebrate the release of the live-action movie, The Exit 8, we have released an update adding new anomalies. A sale is also underway, so please enjoy playing The Exit 8 alongside the movie!

notes.title: PatchNote Ver1.0.7
notes.content: A bug in the save data deletion function added in Ver 1.0.6 has been fixed.

notes.title: Patch Note Ver1.0.6
notes.content:
・Delete saved data function added.
・The contents of the credits have been updated.
・Exit number signs are also no longer displayed when the guide is not displayed.

notes.title: PatchNote Ver1.0.5
notes.content:
▪ Changed the specification where the exit count does not advance in the first week passage, such as when starting the game or after Game Over.
・The bug where an uncle would walk through the passage even if you didn't go through it after clearing the game has been fixed.
・The state in which the anomaly does not occur at the first startup (no guide) was not saved before the game was cleared, so this has been corrected.

notes.title: Patch Notes Ver1.0.4
notes.content:
・Some graphics have been fixed.
・Fixed a bug that caused the screen to go blank when certain steps were taken.

notes.title: Patch Note Ver1.0.3
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug that caused warping in front of a pitch black space.
・Fixed a bug that caused some corridors to look strange.
・Some graphics have been corrected.

notes.title: Patch note Ver1.0.2
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented passageways from being generated.
・Some graphics have been corrected.

notes.title: Update Ver 1.01
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug that caused the game to become inoperable due to a specific anomaly.
・Fixed a bug that caused unexpected clearing methods.
